title: Mixed Duo #023 · 남얼굴 라티나 커브스·블랙 스모키 윙 / 남 V자 보디빌더·펄 화이트 글로시
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the carved stone galleries of Angkor Wat with sunlit sandstone paving, standard-height doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Ethiopian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a clean-cut young male model face with defined cheekbones, a firm jaw and strong straight brows, clean-shaven, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, smooth medium-brown skin with a warm red undertone, a gentle soft smile, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold miniature anvil, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a lead pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three gold rings. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto ankle boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Mexican man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth warm light-brown skin, a gentle soft smile, soft pastel-lavender hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a tin small flared temple bell, a tin cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (an iron hammer head, a tin pyramid-shaped lump, a lead barrel-shaped weight, a gold miniature anvil, a tin cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single silver ring. Extremely long coffin nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
